1.desc: Why do we set out on this adventure?

2.title: What Kind of Traveler Am I?
2.desc: Find your character with a personality quiz

3.title: The Sphinx's Riddle & the Golden Compass

ep1.s1: Long, long ago, every child in the Land of Dreams had a 'Dream Gem' of their very own.
ep1.s2: When the Dream Gem sparkled, they found things they wanted to do, and studying felt like an adventure.
ep1.s3: But one day, the ground shook and the whole world went dark…
ep1.mamba1: I am the Black Mamba! I'm the one who gets in the way of your dreams and studies. This gem is mine now!
ep1.s4: The Black Mamba stole the Dream Gem and vanished into the 'Tower of Darkness'. Without their gem, the children forgot what they wanted to do.
ep1.s5: One night, a golden door opened in front of the four friends.
ep1.angel1: Hi! I'm Sparkle, the starlight spirit who woke up inside the Golden Compass!
ep1.angel2: We need your help to get the Dream Gem back! Come with me across the wilderness to find the Black Mamba!
ep1.angel3: The adventure has six stages. Get to know yourself, find your study energy, find your Black Mamba, beat it with your own strategy… and we'll get the Dream Gem back!
ep1.partyI: It's way more fun when we all go together!
ep1.partyS: Slow and steady, so nobody gets hurt~
ep1.partyC: Route calculated. We're good to go.
ep1.n2: Just then, something came slinking out of the sand.
ep1.devil1: Sssso~ why walk through this hot wilderness? Let's rest here for just 5 minutes~
ep1.devilRest: Hehe, 5 minutes turns into 50 before you know it~
ep1.angelRest: Rest is important too! But let's decide how many minutes first. Then Slinky can't beat us!
ep1.devilGo: Hmph… next time I'll get you for sure!
ep1.angelGo: Awesome! You just beat a temptation. Confidence gauge UP!
ep1.angel4: More temptations like Slinky will show up. But as long as we're together, we'll be fine. Next episode, let's find out what kind of traveler you are!
ep1.sI: Around that time, there were friends shining in their own places. The Empathy Mage cast spells that made friends laugh,
ep1.sD: the Flame Knight always led the way, training alongside friends,
ep1.sS: the Pat-Pat Healer stayed by sick friends and comforted their hearts,
ep1.sC: and the AI Strategist solved hard problems step by step with an AI buddy.
ep1.s6: By day a cloud shaded them from the hot sun, and by night a firelight showed them the way. The travelers' adventure had begun!
ep1.selfI: Ta-da! I'm the Empathy Mage. My magic reads friends' hearts and makes everyone smile!
ep1.selfD: I'm the Flame Knight! I'll lead the way through anything hard. Follow me, everyone!
ep1.selfS: I'm the Pat-Pat Healer. Whenever a friend is having a hard time, I'll be right there to comfort them.
ep1.selfC: I'm the AI Strategist. With my Quick-Calc AI, I can solve any problem step by step.

ep2.intro1: To cross the wilderness, first you need to know yourself. What kind of traveler are you?
ep2.intro2: There are 24 questions. For each one, pick the ONE that sounds most like you. There are no wrong answers, so be honest!
ep2.tieTitle: Both characters are part of you!
ep2.tieFirst: Which character do you want to adventure with?
ep2.tieSecond: Which one feels like your second side?
ep2.subLine: And you have a little bit of the {job}, too!
ep2.angelResult: Wow! Now you have your very own character. Remember your strengths and growth keywords!

ep3.intro1: Past the hot, sandy wind, giant pyramids and a Sphinx appeared.
ep3.sph1: Halt, travelers! To pass this way, you must solve my riddles.
ep3.sph2: There are two kinds of study energy: 'Passion Energy', when you study because you like it and are curious, and 'Reward Energy', when you want praise or prizes.
ep3.sph3: Now, my riddle. Which energy is this?
ep3.sph4: Well done. Both energies are precious. Reward Energy lights the fire fast, and Passion Energy keeps it burning for a long time.
ep3.myEnergyQ: So, which energy do you mostly study with?
ep3.myEnergyA: Very well, I shall remember. Knowing your own energy is the first step.
ep3.angel1: Now let's learn about the heart gauges! When they're full, we have the power to study.
ep3.sph5: Now that you know your heart gauges, you are ready to receive the Golden Compass!
ep3.sph6: But not just anyone may hold this compass. Only one who truly wants something from within may have it.
ep3.sph7: So which gauge do you need for that?
ep3.optPassion: ❤💎 Passion Energy and the Dream Gauge
ep3.hint: Hmm… that matters too, but where does 'truly wanting something' come from? Choose again.
ep3.correct: Exactly! When you have love for something (passion) and a dream, the compass points the true way.
ep3.compass: The Sphinx handed over the Golden Compass!
ep3.angel2: Wow, the Golden Compass is shining! Shall we write down where it points?
ep3.angel3: Awesome! In the next episode, let's go find the Black Mamba that gets in the way of our studies!
ep3.gaugeSub: The fuller the lower gauges are, the easier it is to fill the ones above.
ep3.checkSub: Tap every sentence that sounds like you. There are no right answers!
ep3.resultTop: The heart gauge that matters most to you: {names}!
ep3.resultNone: You haven't picked any yet. That's okay, you can figure it out slowly!
ep3.goalSub: Write a goal you want to reach through studying, or who you want to become. (You can skip this.)
ep3.goalPlaceholder: e.g. Solve math problems on my own
ep3.goalPrivacy: 🔒 What you write here stays on this device only and is never sent anywhere.
goalExamples: Raise my hand and speak in class
Study on my own for 20 minutes a day

ep4.intro1: As they followed the Golden Compass deep into the wilderness, the ground shook hard!
ep4.mamba1: The Black Mamba appears! I am the Black Mamba! I'm the one who gets in the way of your dreams and studies!
ep4.mamba2: I have many forms. I hide in your heart, in your thoughts, and in your actions!
ep4.angel1: Know yourself and know your enemy, and you'll win every battle! First, let's find out who your Black Mamba is.
ep4.angel2: It's the Black Mamba card game! Pick at least one card that's like you from Heart, Thought, and Action, at least 3 cards in all.
ep4.angel3: Found them! Now let's draw your very own Black Mamba. Write what it says to you, too.
ep4.mamba3: Hmph, so you found me? Doesn't matter!
ep4.n2: The Black Mamba swung its tail, and all the travelers fell down…
ep4.angel4: When the Black Mamba gets you, you lose your energy and don't want to do anything. But it's okay. We can get back up!
ep4.n3: When Sparkle's light touched them, the travelers got back up one by one.
ep4.mamba4: I'll back off for today… but I'll never give back the Dream Gem!
ep4.angel6: Remember: the Black Mamba is not you. It's just something that shows up now and then to get in your way. The problem is the Black Mamba, not you.
ep4.angel7: And here's the good news: among the Cloud and Fire Pillar cards, some can already beat your Black Mambas. Add the energy you found, and you can win!
ep4.angel5: Now we know who our Black Mambas are! Next episode, let's make a strategy to beat them with the power of the Pillars of Cloud and Fire!
ep4.gameSub: What gets in the way of my studying? Pick the cards that are like you.
ep4.need: Heart {h} · Thought {t} · Action {a} (at least 1 each, up to 3 each)
ep4.full: You can pick up to 3 in this group
ep4.missing: Please pick at least one {cats} card
ep4.freqTitle: How often does it show up?
ep4.freqSub: Choose how often each Black Mamba shows up for you.
ep4.drawSub: Tap the squares to color them. Make it however you like!
ep4.sayLabel: What does my Black Mamba often say to me?
ep4.drawPrivacy: 🔒 Your drawing and words stay on this device only and are never sent anywhere.

ep5.intro1: The travelers reached the end of the wilderness, in front of the Tower of Darkness.
ep5.angel1: This is where the Black Mambas live. Now it's time to fight back with the Pillar of Cloud and Fire cards!
ep5.angel2: When a Black Mamba attacks, choose a solution card to beat it. Pick the right one and it'll be super effective!
ep5.cloudFire: ☁ Cloud cards calm your heart, and 🔥 Fire cards get you moving right away.
ep5.exp: [{card}] was added to your strategy cards!
ep5.heal: Sparkle filled up your energy! Keep going!
ep5.next: But another Black Mamba is coming…
ep5.stomp: Last step! Let's all stomp on the Black Mamba's head together!
ep5.stompDone: THUD! The travelers teamed up and stomped on the Black Mamba's head!
ep5.highfive: We did it! High five, everyone! 🙌
ep5.angel3: Amazing! Now you know what to do when a Black Mamba shows up. Next episode, let's finally get the Dream Gem back!
ep5.summarySub: The strategy cards you used to beat your Black Mambas.
ep5.noMamba: You haven't found any Black Mambas yet, so let's face the wild ones!
ep5.tut1: Wait! Before we fight, let me show you how. After the Black Mamba attacks, 4 solution cards will appear at the bottom.
ep5.tut2: Tap the one card you think will beat the Black Mamba. ☁ Cloud cards calm your heart, and 🔥 Fire cards get you moving.
ep5.tut3: Not sure which card works? Tap the 💡 Hint button at the top right. I'll give you a clue!
ep5.tut4: Don't like any of the cards? Tap 🔄 New cards to get 4 new ones. You can do it as many times as you want!
ep5.tut5: Pick the perfect card and it's 'super effective!', knocking down the Black Mamba's HP a lot. Other cards still work a little, so don't worry!
ep5.tips: 💡 Hint: shows which cards work well · 🔄 New cards: get 4 new cards

ep6.intro1: The travelers finally returned to the Village of Dreams. But the village was still covered in darkness.
ep6.mamba1: You came all this way? You'll never get the Dream Gem! You'll give up again in the end!
ep6.angel1: Now we know who you are, and how to beat you!
ep6.angel2: Our last power is a 'promise'. Follow the GROW map to make your own action plan. That promise will be the strongest power of all!
ep6.angel3: Great, stamp the promise! Now let's gather everyone's power!
ep6.blast: The travelers' promises turned into a dazzling light and flew at the Black Mamba!
ep6.mamba2: Aaagh! Th-this light…! I dropped the Dream Gem…!
ep6.n2: When the Dream Gem returned to its place, light began to spread through the village again.
ep6.n3: The children remembered what they wanted to do, and studying became an exciting adventure again.
ep6.angel4: {name}, you were amazing! The Black Mamba may show up again. But now you have your character, your energy, your strategies, and your promise.
ep6.angel5: Your profile card is complete! Save or print it and put it where you can see it. Look at it whenever things get hard!
ep6.gSub: This is where the Golden Compass pointed. Write the goal you want to reach.
ep6.rSub: How am I doing now? Think about the Black Mambas that get in the way.
ep6.oSub: These are the strategy cards that beat your Black Mambas. Pick what you'll try. (You can pick more than one.)
ep6.wSub: Decide when, how long, and what. Smaller promises are easier to keep!
cheers: Mistakes are okay, just try again
ep6.gPh: e.g. Solve math problems on my own
ep6.rPh: e.g. I keep putting off homework when I play games
ep6.needW: Let's set one promise for this week! (Choose or write when, and write what)
ep6.privacy: 🔒 What you write here stays on this device only and is never sent anywhere.
ep6.whenOwn: ✏ Not here? Write your own (e.g. Saturday afternoon)
ep6.longOwn: ✏ Write your own (e.g. 45 min, until I finish 5 problems)
